texts.zh:
我们已经破译出[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]足够多的语言，现在我们可以与他们进行通讯——并理解他们先前的广播。

事实证明，解释很简单，也很可怕。我们还不知道是什么原因导致了他们社会的这种发展，但事实证明，[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]一心一意要灭绝所有感性的，非[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesName]生命形式。他们认为这些人是对宇宙中所有正确和美好事物的侮辱。

这就是为什么，当他们发现我们的时候，就开始广播他们的标准问候语——战歌。我们只能认为它们的战舰会迅速跟进。
texts.en:
We have managed to decipher enough of the language used by the civilization we now know to be the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] to open communications with them - and to make sense of their earlier broadcasts.

The explanation, it turns out, is simple - and horrifying. We are not yet sure what caused this development in their society, but it turns out the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are single-mindedly determined to exterminate all sentient, non-[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesName] lifeforms, considering them to be an affront to all that is right and good in the universe.

This is why, when they caught sight of us, they began to broadcast their standard greeting - a warcry. We can only assume their warships will swiftly follow.

label.zh: 我们会准备好面对他们。
label.en: We will be ready for them.
